sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3425 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.44 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Adavuladeevi Police Station, Guntur District,
against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 IPC and Sections 57(2), 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Criminal Petition No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.44 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Adavuladeevi Police Station, Guntur District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed; consequently, no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
